posts.title: GoToSocial 🦥
posts.description: In 2018 I switched from Twitter to Mastodon. I was rather confused in the beginning. I didn’t quite grasp the concept of all these servers being connected but that you should login on your home server. I also struggled to find people to follow. After I read up on how Mastodon worked the concept landed. I hadn’t quite found a place I wanted to call home though. What I really wanted was my own Masto
